messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-07-30] standup/atlas/2025-07-30: Team change: Tomasz leaves team Atlas and joins team Dune, effective today. On-call for Atlas passes from Tomasz to Priya with the move.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07: Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Lena Fischer today.
- [2025-07-17] standup/atlas/2025-07-17: The ledger remains a Atlas service.
- [2025-09-04] standup/dune/2025-09-04: Tomasz Nowak picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today.
- [2025-04-07] standup/ember/2025-04-07: Per the change policy, the webhooks service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. Heads-up from the Ember team: the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.
- [2025-04-18] standup/boreal/2025-04-18: Deploys to the event bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2025-04-14] standup/cinder/2025-04-14: The catalog service calls the resizer for thumbnails, so treat the resizer as a hard dependency of the catalog service.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09: First on-call rotation for team Atlas goes to Tomasz.
- [2025-03-07] handover/2025-03-07-billing-api: Billing-api has a new home: the Ember team. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-04-03] standup/atlas/2025-04-03: Reminder from team Atlas: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Priya.
- [2025-05-13] standup/atlas/2025-05-13: The Atlas team on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-11-04] standup/atlas/2025-11-04: Reminder that the billing API depends on the ledger.
- [2025-02-12] standup/atlas/2025-02-12: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2026-06-04] standup/atlas/2026-06-04: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction: Fixing an error in the 2025-06-09 handover: the new owner of billing-api is Atlas. Team Boreal was recorded by mistake and never held it.
- [2025-03-04] standup/atlas/2025-03-04: If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens.
- [2026-04-08] standup/atlas/2026-04-08: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Priya. The Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-07-21] standup/ember/2025-07-21: Ember runs its planning on Fridays.
- [2025-07-24] standup/dune/2025-07-24: The Dune team sits on the fourth floor.
- [2025-01-07] standup/boreal/2025-01-07: Lena and Marcus make up the Boreal team.
- [2026-04-01] handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer: From today the pager for the search indexer rings the Boreal team, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-07-29] standup/ember/2025-07-29: Policy: every auth-gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-07-17] standup/cinder/2025-07-17: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki Tanaka hands the pager to Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-02-07] standup/ember/2025-02-07: Dependency map update: scheduler needs the feature flag service (per-job kill switches).
- [2026-03-20] standup/boreal/2026-03-20: Marcus moves from team Boreal to the Atlas team today. On-call for Boreal passes from Marcus to Lena with the move.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2: The Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-13] standup/dune/2025-01-13: First on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.
- [2025-01-09] standup/cinder/2025-01-09: Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.
- [2025-04-21] standup/dune/2025-04-21: The Dune team adopted a monthly game day.
- [2025-04-29] standup/ember/2025-04-29: The scheduler still relies on the feature flag service; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-04-02] standup/ember/2025-04-02: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-3: Release captain for Q3 2025: Farah.
- [2025-04-24] standup/cinder/2025-04-24: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki hands the pager to Diego.
- [2025-01-14] standup/ember/2025-01-14: Oskar takes the first the Ember team on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-04-15] standup/dune/2025-04-15: The reports pipeline must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands.
- [2025-04-24] standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2: Heads-up from the Cinder team: feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.

Question: Who was on call for Atlas on 2025-07-04?
